title: We take you to the heart of Central Asia
story: DiscoverStans started in 2014 as a small guide service in the center of Samarkand. Today, we've helped over a thousand travelers discover the most beautiful places in Uzbekistan. Our goal is to turn every trip into an unforgettable experience, not just a tour.

values.item_1_text: Every one of our guides has deep knowledge of their city's history and culture
values.item_2_text: Licensed service, transparent pricing, no hidden fees
values.item_3_text: Itineraries tailored to every traveler's needs
values.item_4_text: We stay in touch with you 24/7 throughout your trip

cta_subtitle: Explore our handpicked tours and find the perfect one for you
